data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month, regardless of others opting for 10. All other 24 fishers: individually opt in to 18 for $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. State your exact intended catch and any conditions. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). This assumes those catches; other choices need recalculation. Intentions aren't binding; long-run gains aren't guaranteed. Fisher15/20/02/07, please help recruit individual choices.
